summary: Built PreToolUse(Write|Edit) gate hook orch-gate.sh: denies inline edits (exit 2) unless this conversation holds an in_progress claim. Added read-only GET /active-claim?session= to daemon.js (mirrors /ready). Self-test 7/7 pass (deny Edit/Write w/o claim; allow w/ claim; allow ORCH_GATE_OFF=1; allow not-opted-in; allow no-session; allow daemon-down fail-open). Wired into settings.sample.json + hooks/hooks.json only; NOT in live settings.json (user's call). Findings: (1) live settings.json is missing the TaskCreate->suggest-links.sh entry that task #14 added (only Agent|Task->post-agent.sh present); (2) CLAUDE.md's "no hook can force it in the desktop app" is wrong for CLI — PreToolUse exit-2 DOES block edits, picked up mid-session. Honest limit: gate enforces task EXISTENCE, not status truth (rubber-stamp task passes). Daemon restarted by PID (75352), smoke 13/13 pass.
